description:
## Goal

Compile each byte-identical fixture/configuration/front-door observation once and fan its immutable typed result into every permanent pure ratchet that asks the same question. Preserve two genuinely separate compiler processes per fixture so cross-process determinism remains a real boundary.

## Implemented model

- `TARGET_FIXTURES` is the one deterministic inventory of the three target fixtures and their output goldens.
- `produce_target_observations` invokes one producer per inventory row in inventory order. Its exact injected oracle was RED at 6 productions versus the required 3, then GREEN at exactly 3.
- Each `TargetObservation` owns exactly two distinct `ProcessObservation` values produced by `fz2 interp --log-telemetry ... --dump backend=...`. Each process result contains runtime output, stderr, a parsed and replayed `CausalReport`, the canonical callable-resolution set, and the canonical backend dump.
- The public-trace, causal-work, and backend-identity ratchets borrow the same immutable bundle. None compiles, reparses, mutates, caches, or reconstructs it.
- The old causal and backend tests each owned a three-fixture/two-process loop: 6 bundle productions and 12 compiler subprocesses. The combined gate owns 3 bundle productions and 6 compiler subprocesses. The original shorthand 6 -> 3 described bundle productions; this explicit subprocess count is the executable truth.
- Each process gets unique telemetry and backend paths from the existing process-id plus atomic-nonce path owner. One RAII owner reads and removes each output on success and removes partial output on early return. A 32-thread test proves paths are unique, content remains owned through the read, and every file is absent after consumption.
- There is no global observation cache. The one admitted key is the exact source plus the fixed interp/public-JSONL/backend-dump configuration. No feature, environment, stress setting, telemetry subscription, target door, or process observation is shared across a distinct key.

## Ratchet contracts

- `public-trace` preserves successful golden output, empty stderr, recursive-search non-vacuity, complete canonical dictionaries, no undefined first use, the f98 zero-uncaused constraint, and no unknown callable surface type.
- `causal-work` preserves equal runtime output, more than 1,000 canonical work entries per fixture, and exact canonical multiset equality between the two processes.
- `backend-identity` preserves a non-vacuous backend, no raw `Ty` rendering, exact canonical callable-resolution identity, and byte-identical canonical backend output.
- Every failure is structured with exact fixture, interp door, public-JSONL subscription, backend dump configuration, producing process or cross-process comparison phase, named ratchet, and detail. Deliberately broken synthetic observations prove all three consumer labels independently.
- Fixture-matrix expected-fatal, panic, timeout, filter, readiness, telemetry, and build-output classifications are untouched. This ticket neither changes nor duplicates the distinct fz-tfn.28 readiness race and fz-tfn.29 fixture telemetry ownership work.

## Required deletion

Deleted the second three-fixture producer loop, the duplicated fixture inventories and filters, four independent backend/trace path variables per fixture, duplicate public-trace parsing/callable projection, and the old per-ratchet manual cleanup. No compatibility adapter or temporary scaffold remains.

## TDD and verification

- RED: `target_fixture_observations_are_produced_once_per_fixture` reported left 6 / right 3 before the fan-out change.
- GREEN: exact production/order oracle; all three deliberate consumer failures; 32-way parallel temporary ownership; the consolidated real six-process target gate.
- The consolidated real gate passed in 42.20 seconds and the full affected `fz2_cli` integration target passed 27/27 in 42.98 seconds. These durations are corroborative only; 12 -> 6 subprocess compilations is the deterministic performance signal.
- Full library passed 1,774 with 6 ignored in 87.69 seconds.
- Workspace all-target/all-feature check and strict clippy passed; documentation tests passed with 1 ignored; formatting and diff checks passed.
- `.agent/docs/performance-instrumentation.md` names the combined reproduction command and the exact 6 bundles / 12 subprocesses -> 3 bundles / 6 subprocesses model.

## Final acceptance state

The implementation is intentionally uncommitted and unpushed pending the required ticket-scoped cold adversarial review. The final staged SHA-256 and any review correction must be recorded here before the one ticket commit and close.
title: Compile each fixture observation once and fan permanent ratchets over it
